title: Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Ab

sofort


Das erwartet dich

Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management.

Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert.

Das erwartet dich

Plattform entwickeln und gestalten

  • Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle)
  • Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung
  • Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle
  • Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept
  • Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt
Automatisieren und standardisieren
  • GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Erstauslieferung bis zum Day-2-Betrieb vollständig automatisiert
  • Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Tools; Policy as Code für Sicherheit und Governance
  • CI/CD-Integration und Standardisierung der Deployment-Prozesse
Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams und Kunden
  • Platform Engineering für interne Teams: Aufbau von Self-Service-Fähigkeiten, Definition von Standards, Begleitung des Onboardings
  • Aktive Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei der Migration ihrer Workloads in die Cloud-Plattform
  • Verarbeitung von Erkenntnissen aus dem laufenden Betrieb (Monitoring-Daten, Incidents) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Stabilität, Sicherheit und Performance


Das bringst du mit

Must-have

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud- oder Platform-Engineering, in Container-Technologien oder Infrastrukturautomatisierung
  • Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen
  • Erfahrung mit GitOps-Workflows (idealerweise ArgoCD oder Fleet) und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Ansible, Terraform)
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Termine an unseren weiteren Standorten
Nice-to-have
  • Erfahrung mit SUSE Stack oder vergleichbaren Kubernetes-Management-Plattformen
  • Kenntnisse in DevSecOps, Policy as Code oder Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepten
  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Stacks (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana)
Persönlich
  • Systemisches Denken statt Ticket-Fokus, mit Blick fürs Gesamtbild
  • Sicheres Auftreten und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe mit Entwicklungsteams wie mit Kunden
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Erfahrung darin, Themen über Team- und Kundengrenzen hinweg zu steuern


Was wir dir bieten

  • Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze deinen Gestaltungsspielraum, um eigene Ideen zu verwirklichen.
  • Arbeite dort, wo Wirkung entsteht: im Office oder direkt beim Kunden. Homeoffice ist die Ausnahme – dafür bieten wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein Office, in dem man gerne arbeitet und den Tag gemeinsam verbringt.
  • Profitiere von internen und externen Schulungen, die dich fachlich und persönlich weiterbringen.
  • Genieße Benefits wie BusinessBike, EGYM Wellpass, Corporate Benefits und einen Zuschuss für den ÖPNV.
  • Neben einem VWL-Zuschuss bieten wir dir eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und eine Kita-Förderung.
  • Ob Surfen, Wandern, Mountainbiken oder Golfen – bei unseren vielseitigen Mitarbeiter-Events ist für jeden etwas dabei!

title: Product Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Warum LPE Immobilien?

  • Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel.
  • Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren.
  • Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Der Abstand zwischen dem, was ist, und dem, was möglich ist, ist riesig, und wir bauen ihn Stück für Stück zu. Du wärst eine der ersten Personen im Produktteam.


Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Fullstack in TypeScript, vom Kundenportal über das Verwaltercockpit bis zu den Services und der Infrastruktur dahinter, auf der grünen Wiese und ohne Altlasten. Features verantwortest du end-to-end: von der Idee über die Gestaltung bis zum Release, bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer an deiner Seite.
  • Du baust KI-Agenten als Produktfunktionalität für unsere Verwalter und Kunden. Zugleich entwickeln wir unsere eigene Entwicklungsumgebung permanent weiter: ein modernes Setup rund um Cursor und Claude Code, inklusive Agent-Graph-Loops und Harness.
  • Dabei arbeitest du nah an den Nutzern: Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg. Wir sammeln Probleme, bewerten sie und bauen die wichtigsten in festen Cycles.
  • Unser Stack: TypeScript durchgehend, mit React und Next.js im Frontend und Node im Backend, als Monorepo auf Google Cloud (Infrastructure as Code), dazu Postgres und event-getriebene Prozesse. Du musst nicht alles davon kennen, den Rest lernst du bei uns.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • 2 bis 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Webentwicklung.
  • Sichere Praxis in TypeScript oder JavaScript, idealerweise mit React oder Next.js.
  • Ein aktuelles Projekt, das du zeigen kannst: Produktionscode, Side Project oder Open Source.
  • Du arbeitest gern quer über den ganzen Stack und magst Frontend und Backend ähnlich gern.
  • Du verantwortest Features end-to-end und kannst bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer ein gutes Interface gestalten.
  • KI-Tooling ist Teil deines Arbeitsalltags, und du prüfst die Ergebnisse genauso kritisch, wie du sie nutzt.
  • Grundverständnis von Datenbanken (SQL) und API-Design.
  • Du willst verstehen, warum etwas gebaut wird, bevor du es baust.
  • Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B2-Niveau.
Du erfüllst nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Talent und Lernkurve zählen bei uns mehr als Jahreszahlen im Lebenslauf.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Eine seltene Ausgangslage. Wir bauen Software für ein Geschäftsmodell, das bereits funktioniert, und wissen, dass sie gebraucht wird. Du erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie sich eine ganze Branche neu erfindet, und gestaltest das aktiv mit.
  • Echter Impact. Alles, was du baust, kommt bei unseren Verwaltern, Eigentümern und Kunden direkt zum Einsatz.
  • Eine Branche von innen kennenlernen. Die Immobilienwirtschaft ist einer der größten Märkte Deutschlands und steht erst am Anfang ihrer Digitalisierung. Du lernst sie dort kennen, wo die Entscheidungen fallen.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Produktverantwortlichen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und jemand, der sich Zeit für deine Fragen nimmt.

description:

  • Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter.   • Für Design ist das ein seltener Ausgangspunkt: Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Für diese Berufe hat noch nie jemand ernsthaft gestaltet. Du wärst die erste Design-Person in unserem neuen Produktteam und baust Design-System und Designprozess mit auf.


Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben

  • Wir arbeiten als ein Team von Product Engineers, manche technischer, manche gestalterischer. Du wärst die gestalterischste Person, arbeitest aber im selben Repository und Rhythmus wie alle anderen. Was du gestaltest, ist meist wenige Wochen später live.

description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.


Who We Need

We’re looking for an accountant who wants to be a builder—whether you’ve already moved into a client-facing/solutions role or you’re a current accountant ready to apply your craft with modern tools. Having previous professional accounting or audit experience will allow the candidate to build immediate trust with our customers.

You’ll own the long-term relationship with our customers after sales and implementation, partnering with CFOs, Controllers, and Accounting Managers to deliver scalable, automated solutions on Rillet’s AI platform. If you enjoy solving complex accounting problems, client interaction, system configuration, and measurable impact—but don’t have a traditional “Customer Success” background—this role is for you.


What You'll Do

  • Own customer relationships and outcomes: Build deep relationships across your customer portfolio, run success plans, and hold recurring meetings to maximize value attainment of Rillet.

  • Deliver unique AI-driven accounting solutions: Translate complex accounting challenges into automated workflows powered by Rillet’s AI platform.

  • Apply accounting expertise: Bridge the gap between technical product capabilities and customer accounting needs, ensuring solutions meet real-world requirements.

  • Drive platform adoption and expansion: Lead trainings to ensure customers are continuously enabled on the platform, advise on process optimization and month-end close efficiency.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Provide front-line customer feedback to founders and Product in close to real-time, triage support issues with Engineering, and ensure smooth account handoff with Implementation.

  • Become a Product Expert: Develop deep product expertise in Rillet’s AI-native platform, staying up-to-date on the latest features and functionality.

  • Represent Rillet: You’ll be the face of the company and will apply high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every customer interaction is delightful.


Who We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of hands-on accounting experience (public audit/assurance or industry GL/Close, Revenue, AP, or Consolidations).

  • Understanding of UK GAAP and the end-to-end close process — even better if you have exposure to IFRS and technical accounting concepts like IFRS 15 / revenue recognition.

  • Proven ability to translate accounting requirements into system configurations and automated workflows.

  • Experience with ERPs (e.g., NetSuite, Intacct) and comfort picking up new finance tools.

  • Bias to action, ownership mindset, and high attention to detail in a fast-moving environment.

Life at Rillet

title: Product Manager, Safety & Compliance
description:
CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies.

We’re on a mission to make businesses more human, and humans more impactful. We operate by our values — be intentional, pursue excellence every day, embrace the journey together, and be a good human — every day. CreatorIQ has earned the title of best companies to work for in multiple programs, including BuiltIn LA and NY. It’s been named a Fastest-Growing Company in North America on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for four years, was named a leader in IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Influencer Marketing Platforms for Large Enterprises in 2025, was named a Leader by The Forrester New Wave™: Influencer Marketing Solutions, and has been consistently recognized by G2 as a Leader, and is rated 5 stars on Influencer MarketingHub. We operate in a flexible work model that combines both in-person and remote work to boost collaboration, enhance innovation, and adapt to individual work styles.

We're seeking passionate, innovative minds to join our journey. Be a part of our dynamic team and let's transform the industry together!

Product Manager, Safety & Compliance

CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies use to run their creator marketing programs. Customers include Burson, Delta Air Lines, Google, LVMH, Nestlé and Sephora. Those programs only hold up if the content is brand safe, sponsorships are disclosed, the music is cleared, and every campaign follows the rules in the markets it runs in. You'll own the product that makes that happen.

The core is SafeIQ, our always-on brand safety system. It runs multimodal AI classification on audio, video, images and text across millions of creator posts, and flags risk before it becomes a headline.

If you like turning messy classification and regulatory problems into workflows that risk, legal and compliance teams trust, you'll fit in. We're growing fast, and we work with teams around the world who care about doing great work.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Own the in-app brand safety review and workflow experience end to end, with one goal: shorten the path from "AI flagged something" to "a human made a confident decision." Ship, measure, learn, repeat.

  • Decide how AI classification reaches people: severity, categories, thresholds, review states and false-positive handling. Work with data science on what the models look for across audio, video, images and text, how confident they need to be before surfacing something, and where a human stays in the loop. Make every flag explainable and auditable.

  • Own compliance beyond content risk: sponsorship and ad disclosure under FTC guidelines and their equivalents, music licensing and rights clearance, legal drinking age (LDA) rules for alcohol promotion, and GDPR and regional privacy requirements. Work with Legal, Trust & Safety and regional compliance stakeholders to stay ahead of regulatory change without making every workflow wait on a legal review.

  • Understand the business nuance for API contracts, webhook payloads and data models with engineering so customers can pull safety and compliance signals into their own systems.

  • Work with GTM on positioning, packaging and enablement so what we sell matches what the product does and what regulators require.


Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • You've spent 4+ years in product management or equivalent technical product ownership in B2B SaaS. Titles matter less than the work.

  • You have good product taste. You can look at an AI-generated feature or output and tell good UX from an AI slop, and you can say why.

  • You think critically and independently. You don't take a model's output, a legal requirement, a stakeholder request or a roadmap item at face value.

The Data Science team at CoMind develops the algorithms and machine learning systems that transform raw optical interference signals from CoMind One into continuous, clinically meaningful measurements of cerebral blood flow, intracranial pressure, and autoregulation. Working at the frontier of photonics, physiology, and applied ML, the team's work directly determines what CoMind One can measure, how accurately, and under what clinical conditions.

As Principal Data Scientist, you will be a technical authority for CoMind's data science function, setting methodological direction for signal condition and extraction, personally driving the most complex and highest-impact problems, and providing expert guidance on data science best practice across the team.   • Own signal processing and analysis programmes from research through to validated, production-quality implementations with Software Engineering.

  • Derive achievable performance bounds from instrument and noise models, and use them to drive algorithm selection, requirement setting and design trade-offs

  • Own how the team handles uncertainty and calibration — inference methods appropriate to small clinical cohorts, per-patient estimation with quantified uncertainty, and calibration strategies that make measurements comparable across devices, sessions and patients.

  • Deep expertise in physiological time-series signal processing methodologies.

  • A demonstrated ability to take algorithmic work from research concept through to production-quality, validated implementations in shipped product.

  • Designing device performance evaluation methods where no prior gold-standard exists: simulating physical systems, running sensitivity analysis, identifying failure modes, and developing signal processing solutions to address those challenges.

description:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health.

 

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

About the role

The Applied Machine Learning team owns production systems and pursues new ideas, from conception and prototyping through to deployment, evaluation and iterative improvement.

Working with clinicians, assessors and engineers, we build reliable ML systems that help bring medical devices to market faster, without compromising safety. It’s a domain rich in text, data and expert judgment, with little precedent for much of what we’re building.

You’ll own meaningful problems in how we assess medical devices: define success with domain experts, decide what to build and test, and take ML systems through deployment and measurable improvement in production.

Responsibilities

Things you might work on:

  • Agentic document understanding – Build agents that search, parse and visually inspect messy technical files: scanned certificates, tables, architecture diagrams and thousands of pages of evidence. Find what matters and show exactly where it came from.

  • Harnesses built for evidence – Develop custom agent harnesses for retrieving information across large document collections in varied formats. Preserve source attribution, minimise hallucination, and make deliberate trade-offs between accuracy, latency and cost. Deploy to production.

  • Evals wired into real workflows – Define success with assessors and build datasets and benchmarks that capture a complex, nuanced domain. Measure retrieval quality, citation correctness and agreement with expert judgment alongside the impact on assessor effort, assessment quality and customer experience, including rework. Use the results to choose what to improve next.

  • Applied AI alignment – Build useful agents that respect the impartiality and objectivity required of a certification body. Help people understand the evidence, recognise uncertainty and retain responsibility for consequential judgments.

Who you are

  • Creator of datasets – You roll up your sleeves and build the dataset you wish existed, rather than wait for someone else to give you one.

  • Establisher of evals – You think from first principles about statistics and evaluating ML systems. You're suspicious of benchmarks that don't match reality.

  • Builder of agent systems – You understand deep-learning, agent tools, context management and information retrieval, and how they interact.

  • Shipper of software – 3+ years shipping software to production. You own deployment, monitoring and the investigation when something breaks.

  • Security judgment – You’ve made and implemented pragmatic security decisions for production systems. You can reason about data access, permissions, untrusted inputs and actions with real consequences; design proportionate mitigations; and recognise when specialist review is needed.

  • Systems design – You’ve designed, deployed and operated production systems. You can choose infrastructure that fits the workload, explain the trade-offs in complexity, reliability, security and cost, and work within shared engineering standards.

  • Hacker – You take ambitious projects from concept to reality with whatever tools are at hand. You experiment, measure and change your mind.

  • Builder – You're insatiably curious about real-world problems and care that what you build has clear economic and human value.

  • Owner of ambiguous problems – You can point to an ambiguous problem you owned: working directly with domain experts to define success, choosing what to try, and following it through experiments and production to measurable improvement.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience deploying agent systems with tool use, sensitive data or consequential actions, including evaluating their behaviour and designing safeguards.

  • Experience building retrieval or document-understanding systems whose outputs must be checked against complex source evidence.

Interview process

  1. Intro call with Alan – 30 mins

  2. Technical interview – 60 mins

  3. Working session in our London office with Alan and Jamie – 90 mins

  4. Culture and values interviews with James and Jamie – 2 × 30 mins

title: People Analytics Analyst
description:
People Analytics Analyst

About Us

ClearBank is a technology-enabled bank built to help transform banking and payments. We combine banking expertise and technology to provide infrastructure that enables our clients to deliver innovative financial products and services. Our culture is founded on trust, accountability, learning, collaboration and the confidence to challenge established ways of working responsibly.

We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

The role:

Reporting to our Head of Reward, as the People Analytics Analyst you will help the People Team make informed, evidence-led decisions by turning data into clear, accurate and actionable insight.

Working across the People Team you will deliver reporting and analysis that supports organisational effectiveness, particularly focusing on Reward and People Operations among the wider team.

You will strengthen data quality, reporting controls and analytical capability across the People function, making insight easier to understand and use while protecting the confidentiality of employee information.

Key Responsibilities

  • Produce regular and ad hoc people reporting that gives stakeholders a clear view of workforce trends, risks and opportunities.

  • Analyse data across the employee lifecycle, including workforce composition, recruitment, retention, progression, performance, absence, engagement and inclusion.

  • Develop accessible dashboards, reports and visualisations that turn complex data into clear insights for People and business stakeholders.

  • Partner with Reward to support pay benchmarking, reward reviews, pay-positioning analysis and other compensation-related activity through accurate data preparation and analysis.

  • Maintain accurate and consistent people datasets, including clear data definitions, validation checks, reconciliation, documentation and version control.

  • Investigate data anomalies and work with People, Finance, Payroll and other stakeholders to resolve root causes and improve source-data quality.

  • Support workforce planning and organisational analysis by identifying patterns, modelling scenarios and presenting evidence-based observations.

  • Provide analytical support for People projects and recurring processes, ensuring outputs are accurate, timely and appropriate for their intended audience.

  • Improve reporting processes through automation, standardisation and the reduction of unnecessary manual activity.

  • Promote responsible use of people data by applying appropriate confidentiality, access, governance and quality controls.

What success looks like in the role:

  • Stakeholders receive accurate, timely and decision-ready people insights that help them understand workforce priorities and take appropriate action.

  • Core People reporting is supported by clear definitions, effective controls and reliable data that stakeholders trust.

  • People analytics increasingly covers the wider employee lifecycle, while Reward receives consistent and high-quality analytical support.

  • Recurring reports and processes become more efficient, scalable and easier to use through thoughtful automation and standardisation.

  • Complex findings are communicated clearly, with appropriate context, enabling stakeholders to understand both the evidence and its limitations.

Skills & Experience:

  • Experience in people analytics, HR reporting, workforce analytics, business analysis or another data-focused role.

  • Strong analytical and numerical skills, including experience working with detailed or complex datasets.

  • Ability to translate analysis into concise insights, clear visual outputs and practical recommendations.

  • Strong Excel capability, including formulas, data validation, reconciliation, data manipulation and structured analysis. Use or advocacy of AI is welcome.

  • Experience producing recurring reports, dashboards or management information for different stakeholder groups.

  • Strong attention to detail and a consistent approach to checking, documenting and controlling analytical outputs.

  • Understanding of data quality, confidentiality and the responsible handling of sensitive employee information.

  • Ability to investigate anomalies, identify root causes and work collaboratively with others to resolve data issues.

  • Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage recurring reporting alongside ad hoc analytical requests.

  • Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical audiences.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience working within a People or HR function in a regulated organisation, financial-services business or technology company.

  • Familiarity with HR information systems, reporting platforms or data-visualisation tools.

  • Experience supporting workforce planning, organisational design, employee-listening or inclusion analysis.

  • Exposure to reward analytics, salary benchmarking, pay-review modelling or compensation data.

  • Experience improving or automating reporting and data processes.

Ways of Working & Culture

  • Care like we mean it: Handle people data with care, respect and discretion, while producing insight that considers its impact on colleagues and the organisation.

  • Build trust together: Take ownership of data quality and delivery, follow through on commitments, exercise sound judgement and raise risks or limitations early.

  • Grow with the challenge: Stay curious, seek feedback and build analytical capability while adapting to changing priorities and new questions.

  • Succeed as one: Work collaboratively across People, Reward, Finance, Payroll and the wider business, engaging stakeholders early and focusing on shared outcomes.

  • Clear a bold new path: Challenge inefficient reporting practices, test better approaches and build solutions that can scale as the organisation’s analytical needs evolve.

Role Level: 2

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

*Please note that we are not currently able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate:

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.

ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation.

_________________________________________________
Director of Communications – International Shows (Touring & Resident)
Sales, Marketing and Communications
Full-Time Position


Reports to: Reports to Vice President - Commercial, Europe, Middle East and Asia with a functional reporting line to SVP, Communication

Scope: All international shows outside the Americas (Europe, UK, Middle East, Africa, Asia-Pacific & Oceania) + Public Affairs
 
Teams: Touring show PR teams (embedded on tour) + Resident show PR teams, and their respective agency rosters
 
 
Role Purpose
 
The Director of Communications – International Shows (Touring & Resident) is responsible for driving demand, building anticipation, and ensuring cultural relevance for Cirque du Soleil’s shows across all markets outside the Americas.
 
This role elevates show communications into a strategic growth engine, integrating PR, earned media, and public affairs to create urgency, unlock market opportunities, and support commercial performance across every international production.
 
Based in London, this role acts as the central show communications and public affairs lead for international markets, ensuring alignment between show storytelling, market-level marketing plans, and cross-functional execution across multiple time zones, languages, and regulatory environments.
 
 
Core Mission
  • Drive anticipation, urgency, and sustained demand for international touring and resident shows
  • Make communications a core lever of the show marketing mix, fully integrated with paid, CRM, and ticketing
  • Lead, develop, and set standards for the touring and resident show PR teams and the agencies that support them
  • Own the strategy and governance of show-specific social media channels as an earned and owned demand driver
  • Leverage public affairs as a growth enabler to unlock market access, market entry, and partnerships
  • Ensure communications is a core driver of ticket revenue and brand equity outside the Americas
  • Orchestrate cross-functional alignment to deliver cohesive show launches across diverse international markets
Key Responsibilities
 
1. Show Communications Strategy – International Touring, Resident Shows & Public Affairs
  • Lead and oversee an international show communications strategy spanning touring productions, resident shows, and public affairs
  • Embed communications within the end-to-end demand engine (onsale → launch → sustain), in lockstep with market marketing plans
  • Integrate public affairs into market entry and growth strategies for new territories
  • Lead communications strategy in support of sponsorships and business development, including building relationships with key stakeholders, and developing joint communication plans with partners
2. Show Communications Leadership (Europe, UK, Middle East, Africa, APAC & Oceania)
  • Own communications strategy and performance across all international touring and resident productions
  • Ensure each show delivers:
    • Clear, differentiated narrative
    • Strong local and cultural relevance, adapted per market and language
    • Full lifecycle comms (pre-onsale → launch → sustain)
  • Implement standards, playbooks, and governance that scale across markets and local agency partners
  • Act as spokesperson for international shows and manage show-level issues in market, escalating to corporate communications at HQ where required
3. Show-Specific Social Media Ownership
  • Ensure each show PR team owns the strategy, management, and community engagement for its show-specific social media channels
  • Set the content, tone, and publishing standards that keep show channels distinctive while consistent with the masterbrand
  • Align show channel activity to the onsale, launch, and sustain calendar in each market
  • Drive creator, influencer, and talent-led content through show channels to build cultural relevance and organic reach
  • Set and track channel performance measures (growth, engagement, referral to ticketing) alongside earned media KPIs
  • Ensure coordination with central brand and social teams on shared assets, escalation paths, and community management protocols
4. Public Affairs & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Leverage public affairs as a strategic growth enabler by building relationships with:
    • Government and public sector stakeholders across international markets
    • Tourism boards, city partners, venues, and cultural institutions
  • Unlock opportunities to:
    • Support market entry for touring and resident shows
    • Facilitate partnerships and local integration
    • Strengthen Cirque du Soleil’s institutional influence outside the Americas
  • Coordinate closely with internal stakeholders to align on regulatory, reputational, and market access considerations, including visas, work permits, and cross-border touring requirements
5. Cross-Functional Orchestration
  • Own coordination across non-marketing functions to ensure aligned execution and messaging around shows, including:
    • Legal
    • HR (incl. talent mobility, immigration)
    • Sustainability
    • Operations
    • Sponsorship & partnerships
  • Act as the central orchestrator ensuring communications supports and amplifies show and market decisions
  • Ensure consistency between internal decisions, external messaging, and market execution, and act as the two-way bridge between international markets and HQ
6. Cultural Relevance & Media Impact
  • Position Cirque du Soleil’s shows as culturally relevant and premium in international markets
  • Build relationships with Tier 1 media, creators, and influencers across the UK, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • Activate cultural moments and partnerships tied to international show launches and runs
7. Team Leadership, Agency Governance & Performance
  • Lead and develop the PR teams embedded with the touring shows and the PR teams responsible for the resident shows, across multiple markets, time zones, and languages
  • Build a consistent operating model, capability plan, and career path across both team groups, including onboarding for new tours and openings
  • Approve and sign off on all agency appointments, scopes, and budgets proposed by the touring and resident show PR teams
  • Define and manage the international agency ecosystem, setting selection criteria, performance standards, and review cadence
  • Set KPIs tied to business impact (demand, awareness, launch momentum, ticket sales, social channel performance)
  • Partner with marketing and analytics to link comms and social to revenue outcomes
Profile & Experience
 
Required
  • 10+ years in communications/PR with multi-market, international leadership experience
  • Proven ability to operate communications as a growth and demand lever tied to sales outcomes
  • Strong experience in consumer, brand, or entertainment PR, ideally with campaign or launch ownership
  • Experience working with government or public sector stakeholders in international markets
  • Deep media relationships across the UK and Europe, with demonstrated reach into additional international markets
  • Experience directly leading distributed, multi-time-zone in-house teams, including teams embedded with touring operations
  • Proven track record appointing, contracting, and managing PR agencies across multiple markets
  • Strong command of organic social media strategy and community management for consumer or entertainment brands
  • Ability to operate in a matrixed, cross-functional environment with a North America–based headquarters
  • Fluent in English (mandatory); willingness to travel frequently across international markets
Preferred
  • Additional language(s) relevant to key international markets (e.g. French, Spanish, German, Arabic, Japanese, Mandarin)
  • Experience in entertainment, touring productions, live events, or premium brands
  • Strong understanding of how communications integrates with marketing, CRM, and revenue generation

description:
About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the Role

We are looking for a Quality Engineer to own test automation across Artificial's product platform. This is a hands-on technical role: we already have a substantial automated test suite - roughly 680 Playwright tests alone, plus extensive backend coverage - but it's grown quickly without a dedicated owner, and needs real structure, consolidation, and meaningful metrics built on top of it. You'll start on Platform, bringing structure to what exists and establishing standards for what gets added next, then extend automation into Transform/customer-configuration testing over time - an area with no automated coverage today, only manual execution by our existing testers, in work that's highly specific to each client.

Key Responsibilities

  • Reorganisation and consolidation: Bring coverage, completeness, and integrity to our existing ~680-test Playwright suite (plus extensive backend coverage) - identifying and removing duplication, fixing or removing flaky tests, and establishing clear structure and naming conventions where the suite has outgrown its original organisation

  • Meaningful metrics: Build real, trustworthy metrics off the back of the existing suite - coverage mapped to actual product routes and features (today's closest proxy, Playwright page objects, doesn't map cleanly to routes), pass/fail trends over time, and flaky-test tracking

  • Ongoing addition and maintenance: Own the suite as a living asset, not a one-off clean-up - adding new automated coverage as features ship, maintaining existing tests as the product changes, and keeping the suite healthy on an ongoing basis

  • CI pipeline scaling: The suite has grown 40% in three months (470 to 680 tests) and is now regularly hitting CI resource limits, with an 8-shard stress-test job approaching a 4-hour timeout. Work collaboratively with the QA Lead and Engineering on a real scaling plan for our existing CI pipeline (Buildkite) - this can't just mean adding more runners indefinitely. You'll be closely involved in shaping this, with full ownership expected to grow over time

  • Clarifying automation boundaries: Work with Engineering and FDE teams to establish a clear, documented relationship between platform-level automated tests and FDE "golden tests," removing current ambiguity about what covers what; also align with the performance testing work already underway so load/performance results sit in the same reporting picture rather than a separate silo

  • Mentorship: Support QA Engineers with automation as they need it - helping them write and troubleshoot tests, sharing what you know, and building their confidence over time

  • Reporting integration: Work with the QA Lead to integrate automated test results into the wider test management approach, so a test failure automatically generates a structured bug report linked back to Linear, rather than issues being created manually on an ad-hoc basis as they are today

  • Cross-team collaboration: Work closely with Engineering (who currently own significant existing automation) to agree a clear, documented handover and ongoing collaboration model, avoiding duplicated effort or unclear ownership

  • Building Transform/config automation from scratch: Once Platform is on a solid footing, extend automated coverage into FDE/customer-configuration testing - an area that has no automated coverage today, only manual execution by our existing testers. Unlike the Platform work above, this genuinely starts with nothing, in an area that's highly specific to each client rather than standard across the platform

About You

  • Strong hands-on experience building and owning test automation frameworks at scale, not just writing individual automated tests

  • Deep experience with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium, including framework design and CI/CD integration

  • Comfortable working in or around a codebase - reading and reasoning about application code, even if not writing production features yourself

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving flaky or unreliable automated tests, and designing tests to avoid these problems from the start

  • Experience establishing test coverage visibility/reporting from scratch, where none previously existed - you'll use this directly when the role extends into Transform/config automation, which genuinely starts with nothing today

  • A methodical, standards-driven approach - you think about frameworks and patterns, not just individual test cases

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance

  • Income protection insurance

  • Life insurance of 4 * base salary

  • On-site gym and shower facilities

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Team social events and company parties

  • Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees

  • Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform

  • Company stock options managed through Ledgy

  • Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy

  • Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays

  • Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook

  • Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams

  • YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines

  • For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action

  • The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us!

We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.

Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.

title: Senior Delivery Engineer
description:
Hi 👋 I’m Dom Allgood, Client Education Manager at hyperexponential. I joined four years ago as a Curriculum Developer and have spent the last couple of years growing Client Education into the (soon to be) five-person team it is today. Before hx I spent a decade teaching Computing in secondary schools. Outside of work most of my time goes to my two children, and what's left to running and, more recently, mountain biking - where I'm still very much a beginner.

Client Education exists to get our customers to value as quickly as possible, and to keep them there. We run instructor-led training, own hx Academy where all our self-paced learning content lives, own the certification programme, and run some of our customer events. We've also recently taken ownership of Developer+, and that's where this role comes in. Our first customers are working through the programme now, and as it grows it will need to evolve based on what we learn from them.

This isn't a typical Delivery Engineer role, you'll sit in Client Education rather than Delivery Engineering. You'll still work closely with the wider Delivery Engineering team, but your day to day is the customers on Developer+: delivering workshops, running drop-ins, reviewing their code, and shaping the programme around what you learn doing it. You'll partner with Product too, so customers can adopt new enhancements quickly and smoothly. There's no established playbook for this yet, so what matters most is the drive to build one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to own, I'd love to hear from you.

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes — whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision — helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally — already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do — from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Delivery Engineering team

The hyperexponential Delivery Engineering team is a unique blend of engineers, actuaries, mathematicians and data scientists. description:
About us

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.

Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK or Germany.

Please submit your CV in English

About the role:

 Owkin is looking for a Customer Support Specialist to own first-level support for K-Pro, Owkin's AI research platform for biopharma R&D, used by AstraZeneca, Sanofi, Servier and Boehringer Ingelheim.

Our clients have made major investments to access K-Pro, and their contracts come with strict response and resolution SLAs. You will be their first point of contact during business hours: the person who understands their problem quickly, keeps them informed, and gets the right engineering, product or customer success people moving. You will also help shape how support works at Owkin, including where AI and agentisation make it better.

 

In particular, you will:

Own the support flow

  • Own incoming tickets during business hours as the first line of support for all K-Pro clients

  • Triage every ticket: set priority (P1 to P4) and the impacted service, and route it to the right team

  • Keep SLAs on track: follow up on open tickets, escalate early when a deadline is at risk

  • Communicate clear, timely updates to users and CSMs throughout the ticket lifecycled 

 Go deep on the product

  • Diagnose issues directly with users: reproduce bugs, check data and configurations, and give engineers a clean, actionable report

  • Learn K-Pro in depth (its features, the datasets clients use, how login, API access, exports and permissions work, and the research questions clients bring to it) so you can resolve most issues without escalating

  • Recognise when a result looks scientifically wrong and when it's a usage question

Turn support into insight

  • Act as the Customer Success team's eyes on support: flag critical tickets, recurring issues, and signs that a client is becoming dissatisfied, so CSMs can act early

  • Spot patterns across tickets and turn them into product feedback, doc updates or process fixes

  • Track and report on support metrics (response time, SLA compliance, first contact resolution, volume) and give actionable insights to the team.

Own the knowledge base

  • Own the K-Pro help center: write, update and remove articles as new issues are resolved

  • Turn one-off fixes into reusable answers for clients and for the support team

Improve support with AI

  • Identify where automation and AI tools (triage, routing, response drafting, knowledge retrieval) would save time or improve quality

  • Work with R&Tech Operations to build, test and improve these workflows

 

About you

Required qualifications / experience:

  • Proven technical support or customer support for B2B software, ideally SaaS, with enterprise clients

  • A track record handling SLA-bound support with demanding customers, and staying calm under pressure

  • Strong technical curiosity: comfortable with APIs, logs, data and configurations; basic SQL or scripting is a plus

  • Hands-on experience with AI tooling and building or improving agentic support workflows (AI-assisted triage, automated routing, LLM-powered drafting), and the judgment to know when automation fits

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, able to explain technical issues to scientists and to engineers alike

  • Experience with support tooling such as Zendesk, Linear and PagerDuty, or equivalent

  • Able to follow runbooks and escalation paths, and to know when to deviate from them

  • A habit of turning fixes into documentation and patterns into insights

Preferred qualifications/bonus:

  • Experience in life sciences, biopharma or another regulated industry is a strong plus

What success looks like in your first 6 months

  • You handle the full ticket flow for all K-Pro clients with SLAs met

  • CSMs rely on your signals to anticipate account risks

  • The help center covers the most frequent ticket types

  • You have shipped at least one automation that measurably improves support 

#LI-HB1

 

What we offer

  • Flexible work organization

  • Friendly and informal working environment

  • Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds

Recruitment Process & Security

  • Please complete the form and submit your CV.

  • Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.

  • Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

  • Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

  • Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

  • The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn and Job Teaser, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @Owkin.com.

  • The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;

  • Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger

  • Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

  • Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

  • Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/

  • Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities

  • Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address contact the following authorities:

    • [FR] https://internet-signalement.gouv.fr/

    • [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime

    • [US] https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/

title: Controller
description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location:

US-based, Remote East Coast

The impact you will have

Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.

The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if

  • Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests

  • The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time

  • Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration

  • Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported

  • Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact

  • Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced

  • At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit

What you will be doing

Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.

Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830.

title: Chief Business Officer (gn) @ Clean Data Centres Venture, France (hybrid)
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio company.

Why we exist

Every frontier model is now gated by two things: megawatts and cooling. Grid queues stretch for years, land is contested, freshwater is political.

Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on Earth, a vast resource the grid can, by definition, never reach.

So we flipped the problem. Instead of bringing power to the load, we bring the load to the power. Our autonomous wind-turbine energy ships chase the wind across the open ocean and convert it on board into what the world needs most: compute first, then e-fuels to decarbonise aviation.

  • 70%+ capacity factor — offshore wind that behaves like baseload

  • ~€50/MWh target cost for firm, low-carbon power

  • Zero grid queue. Zero freshwater. Zero land. And the ocean as the heat sink under every rack.

Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs (with successful exits) and industrial operators. Backed by major international investors. First demonstrator vessel at sea in late 2027.

The role

This is not a sales job. It's a late co-founder seat. You will own Offshore Compute, our first and main commercial engine: strategy, product, pricing, customers and the multi-million-dollar off-take deals that put our first fleet to work.

You already know that power and thermal limits are what will stall AI scaling. You're bold enough to believe infrastructure at sea can get around both, and rigorous enough to prove it to a sceptical buyer.

What you'll do

  • Write the go-to-market from a blank page. Build the global commercial roadmap, from first demonstrator workloads to full fleet monetisation.

  • Land the anchor deals. Negotiate and close off-take agreements, capacity reservations and JVs with neoclouds, AI labs, CSPs and Tier-1 HPC operators.

  • Turn variable power into a feature. Design offers built for wind-backed power profiles: fault-tolerant batch training, asynchronous inference, dynamic pricing, zero-carbon AI clouds.

  • Connect the C-suite to the hull. Translate client requirements (SLA, latency, direct-to-chip liquid cooling) into onboard architecture specs together with our marine engineers.

  • Create a category. Use our advantages — no grid wait, no freshwater, a direct ocean cooling sink, very low carbon intensity — to win premium pricing and long-term commitments, and establish floating compute as a new asset class.

  • Be the face of it. Represent us at the top AI, cloud and infrastructure summits worldwide and make us the reference for next-generation AI energy infrastructure.

You might be the one if

  • You've been in the room where AI capacity gets bought. You've sold, built or run serious infrastructure in the neocloud, AI infra, CSP or hyperscale data center world, and you've closed the kind of deals that move megawatts. We care about what you've shipped, not what your business card said.

  • You know GPU economics inside out. H100 / B200 / GB200 cluster economics, orchestration, workload constraints. And you know the people across the neocloud and AI ecosystem who sign capacity deals.

  • You speak the physics. MW-scale power delivery, PUE, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, thermal budgets. You can explain in one slide why land-based data centers are hitting the grid wall.

  • You've built something from zero. You've scaled a business line, closed complex multi-million infrastructure contracts and thrived with high autonomy and high ambiguity.

  • The ocean pulls at you. You care about climate, and standing on the deck of a floating compute lab during sea trials sounds like the best day of your year.

  • You work in English. Fluent English is required. French is a bonus.

How you operate

  • Owner, not operator. You don't wait for a playbook. You write it.

  • Maths over rhetoric. When a buyer is sceptical about offshore compute, you open the energy and thermal maths.

  • Realistic madness. You have the conviction to break paradigms and the engineering and commercial discipline to deliver.

  • Humble and brave. You stay intellectually humble and still take bold positions, especially where conventional playbooks fail.

  • AI-native. You use modern AI tools for maximum leverage while keeping the domain authority to negotiate directly with C-level executives.

What's in it for you

  • A founding-team seat with executive terms, shaping the company and not just a function

  • A real shot at creating a new asset class at the intersection of AI, energy and the ocean

  • A small, uncompromising team of entrepreneurs and industrial leaders, backed by top-tier capital

  • Flexible hours, a base in Nantes and a mandate that spans the globe

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Search (remote, Europe)
description:
Hey, I'm Adrian. I’m hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Data Search team at Modash.

Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies—including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN—use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships.

Behind that product is a fascinating search problem: helping customers find the right people across 400M+ creator profiles and billions of media files. We’re combining large-scale data processing, traditional retrieval, vector search, multimodal embeddings, and LLMs to make that possible.

That’s where you come in.

Why we're hiring

Search at Modash isn't an internal platform or a support function. It is one of the core products customers use to discover creators.

The scale is large, the data is messy, and the search intent is often complex. A customer might be looking for creators in a specific niche, people whose content conveys a certain visual style, or accounts that resemble a group they already know. Solving that well requires more than adding another filter or calling an LLM API.

We need a senior engineer who can work across the full retrieval system—from data and indexing pipelines to embeddings, ranking, relevance, and low-latency serving—and take ambiguous product problems all the way to production.

You’ll join the specialised Data Search team and work closely with Data Core, Data Insights, product teams, customers, and company leadership. You’ll have real autonomy, but you won’t work in isolation.

If you want a feel for how we think about building software, check our Engineering Blog.

What you'll actually own

1. Make creator search meaningfully better.

You’ll improve how customers discover creators across 400M+ profiles and billions of media files. That includes retrieval, filtering, ranking, relevance, speed, and the product decisions that connect them.

2. Turn multimodal data into searchable intelligence.

You’ll build systems that generate and use embeddings from images, video, text, and audio at massive scale—then make those signals useful in a real customer-facing search experience.

3. Ship new search capabilities into production.

You’ll evaluate models and technologies pragmatically, understand tradeoffs around cost, latency, and quality, and move promising approaches from experiment to a reliable production system within weeks rather than quarters.

4. Own the system end to end.

You’ll help shape the problem, gather requirements, design the architecture, write the code, release it, measure the outcome, and improve it. Senior engineers here own results, not just implementation tasks.

What the day-to-day looks like

Here’s what a typical week might include:

  • Monday. A customer search is returning technically relevant but unhelpful results. You inspect the retrieval and ranking stages, identify where intent is being lost, and propose a measurable improvement.
  • Tuesday. Deep-focus time. You build a pipeline to generate multimodal embeddings across a large batch of creator content and test how the new representation affects retrieval quality and cost.
  • Wednesday. You work with Data Insights on a new in-house datapoint. Together, you agree on its definition, coverage, and data-quality requirements, then expose it in Search to give customers more ways to discover creators.
  • Thursday. You test a reranking model on a fixed set of real customer queries. You measure how much it improves relevance against the latency and inference cost it adds, then decide what's ready for production.
  • Friday. You review production metrics, investigate a relevance regression, and share what you learned with the team. The fix may be in the model, the data, the query logic, or the product itself—you follow the evidence.

We keep meetings purposeful and protect time for deep work. You’ll have a short standup, close collaboration when it helps, and plenty of space to design, build, optimise, and launch.

Requirements

What you've done before

  • Built large-scale data or backend products. You have solid experience working with systems where volume, latency, reliability, and cost all matter.
  • Shipped products from concept to production. You’ve owned scoping, architecture, implementation, release, measurement, and iteration—not just one layer of the solution.
  • Designed distributed systems. You can reason clearly about throughput, failure modes, data flow, scalability, and operational tradeoffs.
  • Built LLM-powered or agentic features in production. You understand the practical differences between models and can balance capability against latency and cost.
  • Worked autonomously on ambiguous problems. You know how to gather requirements, ask useful questions, and turn incomplete context into forward motion.
  • Communicated clearly across teams. You can explain technical tradeoffs to engineers and non-engineers, give direct feedback, and collaborate without creating unnecessary process.
  • Worked in a fast-moving product environment. You’re comfortable learning quickly, shipping incrementally, and changing direction when the evidence does.

Bonus points if you’ve worked with multimodal embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, ranking algorithms, model deployment, self-hosted models, or GPU infrastructure. Curiosity about the creator economy helps too, but we’ll get you up to speed.

Our stack

  • AWS and GCP, with Pulumi for infrastructure as code
  • Python, TypeScript, and Node.js
  • PySpark on AWS EMR
  • Airflow
  • Milvus Vector DB through Zilliz
  • Elasticsearch
  • LLM batch APIs
  • Apache Iceberg
  • SageMaker, DynamoDB, S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, ECS, and Aurora
  • Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion, and Cursor

The interview process

We move quickly and can complete the process in under a week:

  1. Intro chat
  2. Coding interview
  3. System design interview
  4. Team interview
  5. Culture and alignment conversation with our CEO, Avery Schrader

Benefits

What we offer

  • Fully remote in Europe 🏠 Work from wherever you do your best work, with some overlap with GMT+3.
  • Compensation. Your compensation is made up of salary and stock options. As we're growing fast, the stock option package is especially significant. Annual salary range is 100,000€ - 130,000€ for this role. We hire across Europe, so the exact number depends on your location, employment type, skills, and experience.
  • Flexible hours ⏱ We care about outcomes, not when you log on.
  • Unlimited paid vacation 🌴 If you’re rested and happy, you do better work. Take what you need.
  • Personal development support 🧠 Courses, books, and conferences are on us when they help you grow.
  • Real ownership 💡 Take difficult search problems from idea to production without layers of unnecessary process.
  • Regular offsites ✈️ We’re remote-first, but we make time to connect, collaborate, and have fun together in person.

And a little more about us...

Founded in 2018 by a high-school dropout and a Canadian (yes, we’re also shocked it’s going so well), Modash is building a suite of tools that help brands scale partnerships with online content creators.

2,700+ companies like Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN already use Modash to manage and scale their influencer marketing work. And we're just getting started. Over the coming decade, brand investment in creators will continue to boom, and Modash will be at the centre of it all.

Modash is here to stay. We have 8-figures in ARR across two products, a $12M series A investment, and we are default alive. We are building a company that will still be here in 20 years; not rushing towards an exit.

We’re almost 100 people distributed across 20+ countries, operating with a fast, async-first culture. If you join Modash, you’ll be surrounded by people who truly want to be the greatest at their craft. People who make you better. Interesting people too, who have done everything from building solar cars, to hanging out with Metallica and Bon Jovi.

Come join us. Be great, do great things, create great memories, all while making a great impact. Do it.
